about_the_game:
This purchase includes the complete Original Soundtrack (OST) and the OST exclusive Original Vocal Soundtrack (OVST) Hyperdream Edition for a total of 28 tracks!

Disc 1:

Hentai Senpai: Tavern Whores Original Soundtrack, composed by Kink Master Studios.
This soundtrack contains 16 tracks, provided in both mp3 and wav format.

Disc 2 (OST exclusive):

Hentai Senpai: Tavern Whores Original Vocal Soundtrack Hyperdream Edition, remixed by Kink Master Studios. This soundtrack contains 12 remixed vocal tracks from the OST, provided in both mp3 and wav format.

Songs with "(Explicit)" in the title have lyrics and vocals, all other songs are instrumentals.

To access the high quality wav files, go to Steam Settings > Music > Download high quality audio files.
